title: How to Style a Kurta Set for the Office
excerpt: Simple ways to wear a kurta set to work – colours, fabrics, accessories and how to keep it polished for meetings.
body:
A kurta set can look just as polished as a suit – and it is far more comfortable. Here is how to wear one to the office, in India or abroad.

## Choose calm colours

Navy, sage, ivory, soft pink and grey are easy office colours. Small, neat prints look smarter than very large motifs.

## Go for a straight cut

A straight or slightly A-line kurta with straight pants gives a clean, professional line.

## Fabric matters

Cotton and Kota Doria stay comfortable all day. A lined kurta stays neat and is not see-through.

## Keep the dupatta simple

Wear the dupatta neatly over one shoulder, or skip it for a sharper look. You can always carry it for lunch or an evening event.

## Accessories

- Small studs or simple drop earrings
- A watch or a slim bracelet
- Closed flats, loafers or block heels

## For colder offices abroad

Add a fitted blazer or a long cardigan over the kurta. It looks modern and keeps you warm.
